jp-20260814-intro-real-estate-11.title: [Real Estate Studies #11] Houses and Buildings Are Actually Built with 'Other People's Money'

segments.src: > 不動産は金額が大きすぎて「自己資金で買う」ことが前提にならない。だからこそ、住宅ローン・プロジェクトファイナンス・J-REITという3つの資金調達の仕組みが発達した。
segments.tr: > Real estate is too expensive for 'buying with your own funds' to be the standard. That is precisely why three financing mechanisms have developed: residential mortgages, project finance, and J-REITs.

segments.src: 不動産の最大の特徴は、**単価が高く、動かせず、換金に時間がかかる**ことです。数千万円〜数百億円の買い物を現金一括で済ませられる人はほとんどいません。そこで「誰かのお金を借りてくる/集めてくる」仕組みが必要になります。これが不動産金融です。
segments.tr: The biggest characteristics of real estate are that it has a **high unit price, cannot be moved, and takes time to liquidate**. Almost no one can pay for a purchase of tens of millions to tens of billions of yen in cash all at once. Therefore, a mechanism to 'borrow or gather someone else's money' is necessary. This is real estate finance.

segments.src: 代表的なやり方は3つあります。

**① 担保ローン(モーゲージ)** — 買う不動産そのものを担保に入れて、銀行から借りる方法です。日本では登記簿に**抵当権**を設定します。返せなくなれば銀行は物件を競売にかけ、売却代金から優先的に回収します。銀行が見るのは主に2つ。物件価格に対して何割貸すかという **LTV**(例:5,000万円の物件に3,500万円貸せばLTV70%)と、借り手の返済能力(個人なら年収に対する返済比率、収益物件なら **DSCR**)です。
segments.tr: **① Mortgage Loan** — A method of borrowing from a bank by putting the real estate being purchased itself as collateral. In Japan, a **mortgage (teitouken)** is registered on the property registry. If the borrower cannot pay, the bank puts the property up for auction and recovers the debt preferentially from the sale proceeds. Banks mainly look at two things: the **LTV** (Loan to Value), which is what percentage of the property price is being lent (e.g., if lending 35 million yen for a 50 million yen property, the LTV is 70%), and the borrower's repayment capacity (repayment ratio against annual income for individuals, or **DSCR** for income-generating properties).

segments.src: **② プロジェクトファイナンス(PF)** — オフィスビルや物流施設など大型開発で使われます。ポイントは、**「会社の信用」ではなく「その事業が生むキャッシュフロー」に貸す**という発想です。開発案件ごとに **SPC**(特別目的会社)という器を作り、そこに資金と物件を入れる。返済原資はその事業の賃料収入と物件価値に限定され、事業が失敗しても原則としてスポンサー企業の他の資産までは追いかけない——これを**ノンリコース**と呼びます。企業にとっては、失敗したときの傷を1案件に閉じ込められるのが利点です。
segments.tr: **② Project Finance (PF)** — Used for large-scale developments such as office buildings and logistics facilities. The key is the idea of **lending based on the 'cash flow generated by the project' rather than the 'credit of the company'**. An **SPC** (Special Purpose Company) is created as a vehicle for each development project, and funds and properties are placed into it. The source of repayment is limited to the rental income and property value of that project, and even if the project fails, the bank does not, in principle, pursue other assets of the sponsor company—this is called **non-recourse**. For companies, the advantage is that the damage can be contained to a single project if it fails.

segments.src: **③ J-REIT(不動産投資信託)** — 「借りる」ではなく「出資してもらう」側の仕組みです。投資法人が投資家から集めたお金でオフィス・商業施設・物流施設・住宅などを買い、賃料収入を**分配金**として投資家に配ります。投資口は東京証券取引所に上場していて、株式と同じように売買できます。日本では2001年9月に最初の2銘柄が上場しました。
segments.tr: **③ J-REIT (Real Estate Investment Trust)** — A mechanism on the side of 'getting investment' rather than 'borrowing'. An investment corporation buys offices, commercial facilities, logistics facilities, housing, etc., with money collected from investors and distributes rental income to investors as **dividends**. Investment units are listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and can be bought and sold just like stocks. In Japan, the first two issues were listed in September 2001.

segments.src: J-REITには税制上の重要な仕組みがあります。利益の大半(配当可能利益の90%超など、複数の要件)を投資家に分配すれば、その分配金を法人段階の損金に算入でき、実質的に法人税がほぼかかりません(**導管性要件**)。会社と投資家で二重に課税されない分、分配金の利回りが高くなりやすいわけです。
segments.tr: J-REITs have an important mechanism in the tax system. If the majority of profits (e.g., over 90% of distributable profits, among other requirements) are distributed to investors, those dividends can be included as deductible expenses at the corporate level, meaning virtually no corporate tax is levied (**conduit requirement**). Because there is no double taxation on the company and the investor, dividend yields tend to be higher.

segments.src: なお、①②③はライバルではなく**積み重なる層**です。REITも物件購入時に借入を併用します(J-REITのLTVはおおむね40〜50%台に抑えられているものが多い)。
segments.tr: Note that ①, ②, and ③ are not rivals but **stacked layers**. REITs also use borrowing when purchasing properties (the LTV of J-REITs is generally kept in the 40-50% range).

segments.src: 東京・豊洲に住む会社員のAさんを例にします。
segments.tr: Let's take Mr. A, a company employee living in Toyosu, Tokyo, as an example.

segments.src: **朝、住宅ローンの契約書に判を押す。** 5,000万円のマンションを、頭金1,000万円+借入4,000万円、35年・年0.7%(変動)で購入。毎月の返済は約10万7千円、35年間の総返済額は約4,510万円で、うち利息が約510万円です。ここでAさんが知っておくべきなのは、**日本の住宅ローンは原則リコース型**だということ。返済が滞って家を売っても、売却代金で足りなければ残債は消えません(米国の一部の州のようなノンリコース住宅ローンとは違います)。
segments.tr: **In the morning, he stamps the contract for a home loan.** He purchases a 50 million yen condo with a 10 million yen down payment + 40 million yen loan, over 35 years at 0.7% (variable) interest. The monthly repayment is about 107,000 yen, the total repayment over 35 years is about 45.1 million yen, of which about 5.1 million yen is interest. What Mr. A needs to know here is that **Japanese home loans are in principle recourse-type**. Even if you sell the house because repayment is stalled, if the sale proceeds are not enough, the remaining debt does not disappear (unlike non-recourse home loans in some US states).

segments.src: **昼、通勤路で建設中のオフィスビルを見上げる。** これはPFで建っているかもしれません。デベロッパーがSPCを作り、銀行団がそのビルの将来賃料を見込んで融資している。完成前に事業が破綻しても、銀行が請求できるのは原則そのビルとSPCまでです。
segments.tr: **At noon, he looks up at an office building under construction on his commute.** This might be built with PF. A developer creates an SPC, and a syndicate of banks lends money based on the future rent of that building. Even if the project fails before completion, the bank can generally only claim against that building and the SPC.

segments.src: **夜、証券口座を開く。** そのビルが完成して稼働したあと、REITに組み入れられることがあります。するとAさんは数万円〜数十万円で「投資口」を1口買い、あのビルの賃料の一部を分配金として受け取る立場になれます。分配金利回りは時期によりますが、J-REIT全体でおおむね4%前後で推移する局面が多く見られます。
segments.tr: **At night, he opens his securities account.** After that building is completed and operational, it may be incorporated into a REIT. Then, Mr. A can buy one 'investment unit' for tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of yen and be in a position to receive a portion of that building's rent as a dividend. Dividend yields depend on the timing, but there are many phases where the J-REIT market as a whole hovers around 4%.

segments.src: 同じ1棟のビルに、ローン・PF・REITという3つの金融がぶら下がっている——これが不動産金融のリアルな姿です。
segments.tr: Three types of finance—loans, PF, and REITs—are hanging on the same building; this is the realistic picture of real estate finance.

segments.src: ただし共通するリスクもあります。**どれも金利が上がると弱い**という点です。借入コストが上がれば住宅ローンの返済額は増え、PFの採算は悪化し、REITは利払い増と、より高い利回りを求める投資家の売りで価格が下がりやすくなります。不動産金融は金利の世界と直結しています。
segments.tr: However, there is a common risk. **All of them are weak when interest rates rise.** If borrowing costs rise, home loan repayments increase, PF profitability worsens, and REIT prices tend to fall due to increased interest payments and selling by investors seeking higher yields. Real estate finance is directly linked to the world of interest rates.

segments.src: 1. 不動産は高額で流動性が低いため、担保ローン・PF・REITという3層の資金調達が発達した。
segments.tr: 1. Because real estate is expensive and has low liquidity, three layers of financing have developed: mortgage loans, PF, and REITs.

segments.src: 2. 担保ローンは「借り手と物件の信用」に、PFは「その事業のキャッシュフロー」に貸す。PFのノンリコース性が企業の傷を1案件に限定する。
segments.tr: 2. Mortgage loans lend based on the 'credit of the borrower and the property,' while PF lends based on the 'cash flow of the project.' The non-recourse nature of PF limits corporate damage to a single project.

segments.src: 3. J-REITは上場した不動産の共同オーナー制度で、利益の大半を分配する導管性要件により分配金利回りが高くなりやすいが、金利上昇には共通して弱い。
segments.tr: 3. J-REIT is a joint ownership system for listed real estate, and dividend yields tend to be high due to the conduit requirement of distributing most profits, but they are all generally weak against rising interest rates.

segments.src: **Q1.** 「LTV70%」の説明として正しいものはどれ?
segments.tr: **Q1.** Which of the following is a correct explanation of 'LTV 70%'?

segments.src: - (A) 借り手の年収の70%まで借りられる
segments.tr: - (A) You can borrow up to 70% of the borrower's annual income

segments.src: - (B) 物件の価格(価値)に対して借入額が70%
segments.tr: - (B) The loan amount is 70% of the property price (value)

segments.src: - (C) 金利が70年間固定される
segments.tr: - (C) The interest rate is fixed for 70 years

segments.src: - (D) 賃料収入の70%を返済に充てる
segments.tr: - (D) 70% of rental income is used for repayment

segments.src: **Q2.**(O/X)プロジェクトファイナンスのノンリコース性とは、事業が失敗しても原則としてスポンサー企業の他の資産にまで返済を求めない、という意味である。
segments.tr: **Q2.** (True/False) The non-recourse nature of project finance means that even if the project fails, in principle, repayment is not sought from the other assets of the sponsor company.

segments.src: **Q3.**(O/X)J-REITに投資すると、投資家はその物件の一部を自分名義で直接所有することになる。
segments.tr: **Q3.** (True/False) When you invest in a J-REIT, the investor directly owns a part of the property in their own name.

segments.src: - **抵当権** — 借入の担保として不動産に設定する権利。返済が滞れば債権者が競売により優先的に回収できる。
segments.tr: - **Mortgage (Teitouken)** — A right set on real estate as collateral for a loan. If repayment is stalled, the creditor can preferentially recover the debt through an auction.

segments.src: - **LTV(Loan to Value)** — 物件価格(または評価額)に対する借入額の割合。高いほど借り手のレバレッジが効き、貸し手のリスクも上がる。
segments.tr: - **LTV (Loan to Value)** — The ratio of the loan amount to the property price (or appraised value). The higher it is, the more leverage the borrower has, and the higher the lender's risk.

segments.src: - **DSCR(Debt Service Coverage Ratio)** — 年間の純収益 ÷ 年間の元利返済額。収益物件の返済余力を測る指標で、1.0を下回ると賃料だけでは返済できない。
segments.tr: - **DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio)** — Annual net income ÷ Annual principal and interest repayment. An indicator to measure the repayment capacity of income-generating properties; if it falls below 1.0, repayment cannot be made with rent alone.

segments.src: - **ノンリコースローン** — 返済請求の範囲を対象事業・対象物件に限定し、借り手の他の資産に遡及しない融資。
segments.tr: - **Non-recourse loan** — A loan where the scope of repayment claims is limited to the target project/property and does not extend to the borrower's other assets.

segments.src: - **導管性要件** — 投資法人が支払分配金を損金算入するための税制上の条件(配当可能利益の90%超の分配など)。満たせば法人段階の課税が実質的に回避される。
segments.tr: - **Conduit requirement** — Tax conditions for an investment corporation to include dividend payments as deductible expenses (e.g., distributing over 90% of distributable profits). If met, taxation at the corporate level is effectively avoided.

segments.src: *正解: **Q1 → (B)**。LTVはLoan(借入)÷Value(物件価値)なので、5,000万円の物件に3,500万円の借入ならLTV70%。年収基準は返済比率、賃料基準はDSCRという別の指標です。
segments.tr: *Answers: **Q1 → (B)**. Since LTV is Loan ÷ Value, if you borrow 35 million yen for a 50 million yen property, the LTV is 70%. Annual income criteria is the repayment ratio, and rent criteria is another indicator called DSCR.

segments.src: **Q2 → O**。返済原資をその事業のキャッシュフローと資産に限定するのがノンリコースの本質。ただし実務では、スポンサーが一部だけ保証する「リミテッドリコース」も広く使われます。
segments.tr: **Q2 → True**. The essence of non-recourse is limiting the source of repayment to the project's cash flow and assets. However, in practice, 'limited recourse,' where the sponsor guarantees only a portion, is also widely used.

segments.src: **Q3 → X**。投資家が持つのは投資法人の「投資口」で、物件は投資法人が保有します。所有は間接的ですが、その代わり少額から分散投資でき、証券取引所でいつでも売買できる流動性を得られます。*
segments.tr: **Q3 → False**. What investors hold are 'investment units' of the investment corporation, and the investment corporation holds the property. Ownership is indirect, but in return, you can diversify investments with small amounts and gain liquidity that allows you to buy and sell at any time on the stock exchange.*

jp-20260814-news-1.title: Survey of 40 Private Economists Upwardly Revises 2026 Q2 GDP Forecast: Reading the Background of the 1.67% Annualized Growth

segments.src: 日本経済研究センターが定期的に実施している「ESPフォーキャスト調査」で、民間エコノミスト約40人による2026年4〜6月期の実質GDP成長率予測が、前回調査から上方修正されたことが分かりました。今回まとまった予測値は、季節調整済みの年率換算で1.67%増となっており、市場関係者の間で改めて注目を集めています。
segments.tr: The "ESP Forecast Survey," regularly conducted by the Japan Center for Economic Research (JCER), has revealed that the real GDP growth rate forecast for the April-June 2026 quarter by approximately 40 private economists has been upwardly revised from the previous survey. The newly compiled forecast value stands at a seasonally adjusted annualized increase of 1.67%, drawing renewed attention among market participants.

segments.src: ESPフォーキャスト調査は、大手証券会社やシンクタンク、研究機関などに所属するエコノミストの予測を集計し、平均値として公表する仕組みで、政府の公式統計が発表される前の「先行指標」として位置づけられています。今回の上方修正は、直近の経済指標や企業業績の発表内容を踏まえたものとみられます。
segments.tr: The ESP Forecast Survey aggregates and publishes the average predictions of economists affiliated with major securities companies, think tanks, and research institutions, serving as a "leading indicator" ahead of official government statistics. This upward revision is believed to reflect the latest economic indicators and corporate earnings announcements.
## Main Factors Behind the Upward Revision

segments.src: 今回の予測引き上げの背景として、多くのエコノミストが挙げているのが個人消費と設備投資の上振れです。
segments.tr: As the background for this forecast upgrade, many economists cite the upward surprises in private consumption and capital investment.

segments.src: - **個人消費**: 賃上げの動きが幅広い業種に波及したことや、物価上昇のペースが落ち着きを見せ始めたことが、家計の購買力を下支えしたとの見方があります。旅行やサービス消費など、非耐久財以外の分野での支出が堅調だったとの指摘も見られます。
segments.tr: - **Private Consumption**: Some views suggest that the spread of wage hikes across a wide range of industries and the stabilizing pace of price increases have supported household purchasing power. It has also been pointed out that spending in areas other than non-durable goods, such as travel and service consumption, remained firm.

segments.src: - **設備投資**: 人手不足への対応としての省力化投資や、デジタル化・脱炭素関連への投資が、製造業・非製造業を問わず継続しているとされます。企業収益の改善を背景に、投資計画を積み増す動きが一部で見られたことも上方修正の一因と考えられています。
segments.tr: - **Capital Investment**: Labor-saving investments in response to labor shortages, as well as investments related to digitalization and decarbonization, are said to continue across both manufacturing and non-manufacturing industries. The movement by some companies to increase their investment plans against the backdrop of improved corporate profits is also considered a factor in the upward revision.

segments.src: これらの内需項目が想定以上に堅調だったことが、全体の成長率予測を押し上げる形となったようです。
segments.tr: These domestic demand items being stronger than expected appear to have pushed up the overall growth rate forecast.

segments.src: ## 外需や政策要因への言及
segments.tr: ## References to External Demand and Policy Factors

segments.src: 一方で、為替動向や海外経済の先行き、金融政策の運営など、外部環境に関する不確実性を指摘する声も根強く残っています。個々のエコノミストの間でも予測のばらつきは依然として大きく、今回の1.67%増という数値はあくまで平均値である点には留意が必要です。上振れ要因と下振れ要因が併存する中で、平均値としてプラス方向への修正が示された、という理解が実態に近いといえるでしょう。
segments.tr: On the other hand, persistent voices point out uncertainties regarding the external environment, such as exchange rate trends, the outlook for overseas economies, and monetary policy management. Variability in forecasts among individual economists remains large, and it is necessary to keep in mind that the figure of a 1.67% increase is merely an average. While upside and downside risks coexist, the understanding that an upward revision was shown as an average value is likely close to the actual situation.

segments.src: 今回の民間予測を受け、まもなく公表される見通しの政府統計(GDP速報値)の内容に関心が集まっています。民間予測と実際の統計値との間には、算出方法やサンプルの違いなどからしばしば差が生じることがあり、統計発表後にはその答え合わせが行われることになります。
segments.tr: Following this private forecast, interest is gathering on the contents of the government statistics (preliminary GDP figures) scheduled to be announced soon. Differences often arise between private forecasts and actual statistical values due to differences in calculation methods and samples, and verification will take place after the statistics are released.

segments.src: また、今回の調査結果は今後の金融政策や経済対策の議論にも影響を与える可能性があるとされ、関係者の間では引き続き注視が必要だとの声が上がっています。
segments.tr: In addition, the results of this survey are said to have the potential to influence discussions on future monetary policy and economic measures, and voices among concerned parties suggest continued vigilance is necessary.

segments.src: 民間エコノミスト40人による2026年4〜6月期GDP予測が年率1.67%増へ上方修正された背景には、個人消費と設備投資の堅調さがあるとみられます。ただし予測にはなお幅があり、外需や政策動向といった不確実要素も残されています。今後発表される政府統計と合わせて、経済の実態を多角的に見ていく必要がありそうです。
segments.tr: The background behind the upward revision of the 2026 Q2 GDP forecast by 40 private economists to an annualized 1.67% increase is believed to lie in the strength of private consumption and capital investment. However, variations still exist in the forecasts, and uncertain factors such as external demand and policy trends remain. It will likely be necessary to examine the reality of the economy from multiple perspectives, along with government statistics to be announced in the future.

segments.src: ※本記事は公表されている調査結果の概要を基にした一般的な解説であり、特定の投資判断や経済政策を推奨するものではありません。詳細な数値や最新の情報については、日本経済研究センターなど一次情報源の公表資料をご確認ください。
segments.tr: *This article is a general commentary based on the overview of published survey results and does not recommend any specific investment decisions or economic policies. For detailed figures and the latest information, please check the published materials of primary information sources such as the Japan Center for Economic Research.

jp-20260814-news-2.title: Long-term interest rates temporarily rise to 2.853%, reaching a 29-year high: Examining the background "rate hike expectations" and "fiscal deterioration concerns"

segments.src: 2026年8月13日の債券市場で、指標となる新発10年物国債の利回りが一時2.853%まで上昇しました。この水準は1997年以来、約29年ぶりの高さとされています。市場では、日本銀行による追加利上げの観測と、国の財政状況に対する懸念という2つの要因が同時に意識されており、どちらが主因なのかをめぐって様々な見方が交わされています。本記事では、報じられている情報をもとに、長期金利上昇の背景と考えられる要因を整理してご紹介します。
segments.tr: In the bond market on August 13, 2026, the yield on the newly issued 10-year Japanese government bond temporarily rose to 2.853%. This level is said to be the highest in about 29 years, since 1997. In the market, two factors are being simultaneously recognized: expectations of additional rate hikes by the Bank of Japan and concerns regarding the country's fiscal situation, with various views being exchanged over which is the main cause. Based on reported information, this article organizes and introduces the background and considered factors behind the rise in long-term interest rates.

segments.src: ## 長期金利とは何か、なぜ注目されるのか
segments.tr: ## What are long-term interest rates and why do they attract attention?

segments.src: 長期金利は、住宅ローンの固定金利や企業の設備投資資金の調達コストなど、私たちの生活や経済活動に幅広く影響を及ぼす指標です。一般的に長期金利が上昇すると、住宅ローン金利の上昇や企業の借入コスト増加につながりやすいとされ、家計や企業活動の両面で注目されるポイントとなっています。新発10年物国債利回りは、その代表的な指標として市場関係者や報道でたびたび取り上げられます。
segments.tr: Long-term interest rates are an indicator that widely affects our daily lives and economic activities, such as fixed mortgage rates and corporate funding costs for capital investment. Generally, an increase in long-term interest rates tends to lead to higher mortgage rates and increased borrowing costs for companies, making it a closely watched point for both households and corporate activities. The newly issued 10-year government bond yield is frequently featured by market participants and news reports as a representative indicator of this.

segments.src: ## 金利上昇の背景として指摘される2つの要因
segments.tr: ## Two factors pointed out as the background of rising interest rates

segments.src: ### 1. 日銀の追加利上げ観測
segments.tr: ### 1. Expectations of additional rate hikes by the BOJ

segments.src: 近年、日本銀行は金融政策の正常化を段階的に進めており、物価動向や賃金上昇の状況を踏まえた追加利上げの可能性が市場で意識されてきました。将来の政策金利引き上げが予想されると、それを織り込む形で長期金利にも上昇圧力がかかりやすくなるとされています。今回の利回り上昇についても、こうした金融政策の先行きに対する見方が影響したとの指摘があります。
segments.tr: In recent years, the Bank of Japan has been stepping toward the normalization of monetary policy in stages, and the possibility of additional rate hikes based on price trends and wage growth has been recognized in the market. It is said that when future policy rate hikes are anticipated, upward pressure tends to be applied to long-term interest rates as these expectations are priced in. Regarding this recent rise in yields, some point out that views on the future course of such monetary policy have had an influence.

segments.src: 一方で、国の歳出拡大や国債発行残高の増加など、財政運営に対する懸念も金利上昇要因として挙げられています。国債の発行量が増えたり、財政の持続可能性に不安が生じたりすると、投資家が求める利回り(いわゆる「リスクプレミアム」)が上昇し、長期金利を押し上げる方向に働くことがあるとされます。市場の一部では、金融政策要因だけでなく、こうした財政面への警戒感も今回の水準を押し上げた一因ではないかとの見方が示されています。
segments.tr: On the other hand, concerns regarding fiscal management, such as the expansion of government expenditures and the increase in outstanding government debt, are also cited as factors raising interest rates. It is said that when the issuance of government bonds increases or anxiety arises over the sustainability of public finances, the yield demanded by investors (the so-called "risk premium") rises, acting in a direction that pushes up long-term interest rates. In parts of the market, views have been expressed that not only monetary policy factors, but also this sense of caution on the fiscal side may have been a contributing factor in driving up current levels.

segments.src: 実際の金利形成には、金融政策・財政動向に加え、海外金利の動き、物価情勢、需給要因など複数の要素が複雑に絡み合っています。そのため、今回の上昇について単一の原因を断定することは難しく、専門家の間でも意見が分かれているのが実情です。本記事は特定の立場を支持するものではなく、報道や市場で指摘されている複数の見方を整理してお伝えするものである点にご留意ください。
segments.tr: In actual interest rate formation, multiple elements—such as overseas interest rate movements, price situations, and supply-demand factors—are intricately intertwined in addition to monetary policy and fiscal trends. Therefore, it is difficult to pinpoint a single cause for the current rise, and the reality is that opinions remain divided even among experts. Please note that this article does not support a specific stance, but rather organizes and conveys multiple views pointed out in reports and the market.

segments.src: 今後は、日本銀行の金融政策決定会合や政府の予算編成・財政運営方針、物価・賃金統計の発表などが、長期金利の動向を占ううえで注目される材料となりそうです。また、海外の金利動向や為替市場の動きも国内金利に影響を及ぼす可能性があるため、あわせて注視されるとみられます。
segments.tr: Moving forward, events such as the Bank of Japan's Monetary Policy Meeting, the government's budget formulation and fiscal management policies, and the announcement of price and wage statistics are likely to become watched materials for forecasting the trends of long-term interest rates. In addition, overseas interest rate trends and foreign exchange market movements may also affect domestic interest rates, and thus are expected to be closely watched in tandem.

segments.src: 長期金利が29年ぶりの水準まで上昇した背景には、日銀の利上げ観測と財政悪化への懸念という、性質の異なる2つの要因が絡み合っている可能性が指摘されています。今後の金融政策や財政運営の動向次第で金利の水準は変動しうるため、引き続き関連するニュースの推移を見守る必要がありそうです。
segments.tr: It has been pointed out that behind the rise of long-term interest rates to a 29-year high are intertwined two factors of different natures: expectations of BOJ rate hikes and concerns over fiscal deterioration. Because interest rate levels can fluctuate depending on future monetary policy and fiscal management trends, it seems necessary to continue monitoring the progress of related news.

jp-20260814-news-3.title: Where is the vice-capital? Osaka, Fukuoka, and Aichi step forward, with Hokkaido and Miyagi also showing interest in hosting

segments.src: ## 副首都法が示す新たな国土構想
segments.tr: ## A New National Land Vision Indicated by the Vice-Capital Act

segments.src: 2026年7月に成立した「副首都法」は、東京一極集中の是正と大規模災害時のリスク分散を目的に、首都機能の一部を担う「副首都」を指定する仕組みを新たに設けるものです。首都直下地震や富士山噴火など、首都圏に甚大な被害が及ぶ事態を想定し、行政・経済の機能を代替できる拠点をあらかじめ整備しておく狙いがあるとされています。
segments.tr: The "Vice-Capital Act," enacted in July 2026, newly establishes a system to designate a "vice-capital" to shoulder a portion of the capital functions, with the objectives of correcting Tokyo-centric concentration and dispersing risks during large-scale disasters. It is said to aim at preparing alternative bases in advance for administrative and economic functions, anticipating situations where severe damage hits the Tokyo metropolitan area, such as a direct earthquake beneath the capital or a Mt. Fuji eruption.

segments.src: ## 名乗りを上げた自治体
segments.tr: ## Local Governments That Have Stepped Forward

segments.src: 法律の成立を受け、大阪府・福岡県・愛知県の3府県は、副首都の指定を目指す意向を相次いで正式に表明しました。いずれも人口・経済規模で全国有数の大都市圏を抱え、空港や港湾、新幹線網といった広域交通インフラが整っている点を強みとして訴えています。
segments.tr: Following the enactment of the law, three prefectures—Osaka, Fukuoka, and Aichi—successively and formally expressed their intentions to aim for the designation of vice-capital. All of them boast major metropolitan areas among the top nationwide in population and economic scale, appealing to their strengths in well-equipped wide-area transportation infrastructure such as airports, ports, and Shinkansen networks.

segments.src: さらに、北海道と宮城県も誘致に意欲を示していると伝えられています。北海道は広大な土地と再生可能エネルギーのポテンシャルを、宮城県は東北の中心都市としての集積や過去の震災の教訓を踏まえた防災体制を、それぞれアピール材料としているとみられます。
segments.tr: Furthermore, Hokkaido and Miyagi are reported to have shown enthusiasm for hosting. Hokkaido is seen as using its vast land and potential for renewable energy as appealing materials, while Miyagi is highlighting its concentration as the central city of the Tohoku region and a disaster prevention system based on lessons learned from past earthquakes.

segments.src: ## 指定によって何が変わるのか
segments.tr: ## What Will Change with the Designation?

segments.src: 副首都に指定された地域では、政府機関の一部機能移転やバックアップ拠点の整備、企業の本社機能・データセンターの誘致などが進むと期待されています。実現すれば雇用創出や地方税収の増加といった経済効果も見込まれ、指定を目指す各自治体にとっては地域経済の底上げにつながる好機となります。
segments.tr: In regions designated as a vice-capital, expectations are high for the relocation of some functions of government agencies, the development of backup bases, and the attraction of corporate headquarters functions and data centers. If realized, economic effects such as job creation and an increase in local tax revenues are also anticipated, presenting a golden opportunity for each local government aiming for designation to boost its regional economy.

segments.src: 一方で、指定基準や選定プロセスの詳細、複数地域を並行して指定する可能性の有無など、制度の具体像は今後の国の検討に委ねられている部分も多く、正式な選定にはなお時間を要するとみられます。
segments.tr: On the other hand, much of the system's concrete picture—such as the details of designation criteria and the selection process, and the possibility of designating multiple regions in parallel—is left to future deliberations by the national government, and it is considered that formal selection will still take time.

segments.src: 東京一極集中の是正という長年の課題に一石を投じる今回の制度が、実際にどこまで地方の経済地図を塗り替えるのか。各自治体の誘致合戦の行方とあわせて、国による選定基準の明確化や具体的なスケジュールの提示が今後の焦点となりそうです。
segments.tr: How far this new system, which throws a stone into the long-standing issue of correcting Tokyo-centric concentration, will actually redraw the economic map of the regions? Along with the outcome of the hosting competition among local governments, the clarification of selection criteria and the presentation of a specific schedule by the national government are likely to be the focus from now on.
